function updateMaterialParts(_parts:{Part},count:number,prefab:Part)
    local showCount = math.ceil(count/5)
    local max = math.max(#_parts,showCount)
    max = math.clamp(max,0,30)
    for i=1,max do
        local part = _parts[i]
        if i <= showCount then
            if not part then
                part = prefab:Clone()
                part.CFrame = prefab.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,(i-1) * prefab.Size.Y,0)
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.CanTouch = false
                part.CanQuery = false
                part.Anchored = true
                part.Parent = prefab.Parent
                _parts[i] = part
            end
            part.Transparency = 0
        else
            if part then
                part.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
end

function recycleItem(item:Model)
    ResourcesItemHelper:DestroyItem(item,2)

    local sound:Sound = TouchPart:FindFirstChild("运作")
    -- if not sound.Playing then sound:Play() end
    sound:Play()

    local gears1:Model = craftingBenchModel:FindFirstChild("Crash"):FindFirstChild("齿轮1"):FindFirstChild("齿轮"):GetChildren()
    local gears2:Model = craftingBenchModel:FindFirstChild("Crash"):FindFirstChild("齿轮2"):FindFirstChild("齿轮"):GetChildren()
    local Core = craftingBenchModel:FindFirstChild("Crash"):FindFirstChild("Core")
    local attr:Attachment = Core:FindFirstChild("分解起始点")

    CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(Core,true)

    for i,gear1:Part in ipairs(gears1) do
        local tween:Tween = gear1:FindFirstChild("Tween")
        if not tween then
            tween = TweenService:Create(gear1,TweenInfo.new(3,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{
                Rotation = gear1.Rotation + Vector3.xAxis * -360
            })
            tween.Name = "Tween"
            tween.Parent = gear1
            if i== 1 then
                tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
                    CommonFunc:SetParticleEmittersEnabled(Core,false)
                end)
            end
        end
        tween:Play()
    end

    for _,gear2:Part in ipairs(gears2) do
        local tween:Tween = gear2:FindFirstChild("Tween")
        if not tween then
            tween = TweenService:Create(gear2,TweenInfo.new(3,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{
                Rotation = gear2.Rotation + Vector3.xAxis * 360
            })
            tween.Name = "Tween"
            tween.Parent = gear2
        end
        tween:Play()
    end

    local rootPart = item.PrimaryPart
    rootPart.Anchored = true
    local startCFrame = rootPart.CFrame.Rotation + attr.WorldCFrame.Position
    rootPart.CFrame = startCFrame
    local itemTweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(2,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
    TweenService:Create(rootPart,itemTweenInfo,{
        CFrame = startCFrame + Vector3.new(0,-3,0)
    }):Play()

    task.spawn(function()
        local t = itemTweenInfo.Time
        local originScale = item:GetScale()
        while item and item:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
            local dt = task.wait()
            t -= dt
            item:ScaleTo(math.clamp(t/itemTweenInfo.Time,0.01,1) * originScale)
        end
    end)
end

GameHelper.MakeCraftItemC2S.OnServerInvoke = function(player,id:number,source:number)
    if source then return end

    -- 制造台
    local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLo(id)

    -- 限制
    local times = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(id).Value
    if lo.ItemLimit and times >= lo.ItemLimit then
        UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,"The maximum limit has been reached.",UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
        return
    end

    -- 检测是否足够扣费
    local triggerFree = false
    if player:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.BuilderV2) then
        -- 建造者职业有概率不消耗材料
        if math.random(1,100) <= 20 then
            triggerFree = true
        end
    end

    if triggerFree then
        AudioHelper:PlayEffect("HammerFree",player.Character)
    else
        local needs = CommonFunc:ParseKV_Number(lo.PriceType)
        for k,targetValue in pairs(needs) do
            local v_obj:IntValue = v_map[k]
            if not v_obj or v_obj.Value < targetValue then
                UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireClient(player,string.format("Need more %s.",k),UIHelper.TipsStyle.Warn)
                return
            end
        end

        -- 扣除
        for k,targetValue in pairs(needs) do
            local v_obj:IntValue = v_map[k]
            v_obj.Value -= targetValue
        end
    end

    -- times += 1
    -- CraftItemHelper:SetMakeTimes(id,times)

    if lo.isEnhance then
        -- 是否加强
        v_level.Value += 1

        -- 累计制作次数
        times += 1
        CraftItemHelper:SetMakeTimes(id,times)
    else
        if lo.ResItemId then
            -- 创建道具
            local item = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(lo.ResItemId)
            if item:IsA("Tool") then
                ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
            else
                local character = player.Character
                local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local cframe = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
                item:PivotTo(CFrame.new(cframe.Position + cframe.LookVector * 5))
            end
            item:AddTag(CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimesTag(id))
        else
            -- 给予蓝图
            local item = CraftItemHelper:CreateItem(id)
            ToolHelper:Pinkup(player,item)
            item:AddTag(CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimesTag(id))
        end
    end

    UIHelper.onPopCenterTips:FireAllClients(string.format("%s Crafted a %s.",player.DisplayName,lo.ItemName))
    return true
end

function spawnStore(ground:Part,folderName:string?)
    if not ground then return end
    local prefab:Model
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("沼泽Map"):FindFirstChild(folderName or "装饰")
    if folder then
        local childs = folder:GetChildren()
        if #childs > 0 then
            local posX = ground.Position.X
            local posZ = ground.Position.Z
            local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
            local stoneX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local stoneZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            prefab = childs[math.random(1,#childs)]
            local stone = prefab:Clone()
            stone:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0)+Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
            stone.Parent = workspace
        end
    end
end

-- 随机石头
function trySpawnStoreAndTree(ground:Part)
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType == MapHelper.GridType.Marsh then
        local grid1X = gridPoint.X
        local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z
        local posX = ground.Position.X
        local posZ = ground.Position.Z
        local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2

        -- 随机一些树
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        local treeCount = 0
        if zoneLevel <= 2 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,3)
        elseif zoneLevel <= 4 then
            treeCount = math.random(0,2)
        else
            treeCount = math.random(0,1)
        end
        for i=1,treeCount do
            local prefabName = "TreeL"
            local tag = GameEnum.Tag.Tree
            if math.random(1,5) <= 1 then
                tag = GameEnum.Tag.BigTree
                prefabName = "TreeXL"
            end
            local tree:Model = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("沼泽Map"):WaitForChild("树"):WaitForChild(prefabName):Clone()
            local treeX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
            local treeZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)

            -- local rotationY:number = math.random() * 360
            local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
            tree:PivotTo(CFrame.new(treeX,groundY,treeZ) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
            tree.Parent = workspace
            tree:AddTag(tag)
        end

        -- 随机石块
        if math.random(1,3) <= 1 then
            spawnStore(ground)
        end

        -- 生成雪块
        GameHelper:SpawnSnow(ground)
    end

    -- 在沼泽边缘的地块上生成一些装饰
    if ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshEdgeGround) then
        local r = 1
        for offsetX =-r,r do
            for offsetZ=-r, r do
                local grid1X = gridPoint.X + offsetX
                local grid1Z = gridPoint.Z + offsetZ
                if MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z) == MapHelper.GridType.land then
                    local g = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                    if g:HasTag("SpawnedEdgeStore") then continue end
                    g:AddTag("SpawnedEdgeStore")
                    local num = math.random(1,3)
                    for i=1,num do
                        spawnStore(g,"边缘装饰")
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 生成蘑菇
function trySpawnMushroom(ground:Part)
    if not ground:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround) then return end
    if _mushroomSpawnMarks[ground] then return end
    _mushroomSpawnMarks[ground] = true
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    -- local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    -- if zoneLevel > 3 then return end

    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= GridType.Marsh and gridType ~= GridType.ToxicSwamp then return end
    local isSpawn = math.random(1,2) == 1
    if not isSpawn then
        task.delay(300,function()
            _mushroomSpawnMarks[ground] = nil
        end)
        return
    end

    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local posX = ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX)
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    local mushroomId = _mushroomIds[math.random(1,#_mushroomIds)]
    local resItem = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItem(mushroomId,CFrame.new(posX,posY,posZ))
    if resItem.PrimaryPart then
        resItem.PrimaryPart.Anchored = true
    end
end

-- 生成鳄鱼/野猪/火鸡
function trySpawnAnimals(ground:Part)
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 此地块是否会生成
    local gridPoint:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    if gridType ~= MapHelper.GridType.Marsh and gridType ~= GridType.ToxicSwamp then
        -- 如果非普通地块则不生成
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end

    -- 获得敌人随机组id
    local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z)
    local enemyIds = _enemyIdsMap[zoneLevel]
    if not enemyIds then
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
        return
    end

    local enemyId = enemyIds[math.random(1,#enemyIds)]
    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == nil then
        local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = math.random(1,100) <= enemyLo.spawnPercent
    end

    if _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] == false then return end

    -- 是否已经执行过生成，生成过不会再生成
    if _groundAnimals[ground] then return end

    local enemyLo:EnemySetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(EnemySetting,enemyId)
    local parent = EnemyHelper:GetEnemyParent(enemyLo.id)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2 + 5
    local rangeX = ground.Size.X * 0.5
    local rangeZ = ground.Size.Z * 0.5
    local animal = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyLo.id,parent)
    animal:PivotTo(CFrame.new(
        ground.Position.X + math.random(-rangeX,rangeX),
        posY,
        ground.Position.Z + math.random(-rangeZ,rangeZ)
    ))
    animal.Destroying:Connect(function()
        _groundAnimals[ground] = nil
    end)
    _groundAnimals[ground] = animal
    
    -- 如果死掉就不再刷了
    local humanoid:Humanoid = animal:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
        animal:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
        _groundIsCanSpawnAnimal[ground] = false
    end)
    animal:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.AutoStreamingOutDestroy)
    -- animal:SetAttribute("Grid",string.format("%d,%d",gridPoint.X,gridPoint.Z))

    -- Debris:AddItem(enemy,_animalLifeTime)
end

-- 宝箱点
function initTreasurePoint()
    local parent = Instance.new("Folder")
    parent.Name = "沼泽区域宝箱点"
    parent.Parent = _parent

    local prefabs = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("沼泽Map"):FindFirstChild("宝箱资源点"):GetChildren()
    local gridType = GridType.building
    -- local num = math.random(15,20)
    local density = GameHelper.MarshSize / 7 -- 计算密度
    local num = math.random(math.ceil(density * 0.9),math.ceil(density * 1.1))
    local grounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround)
    for i=1,num do
        if #grounds <= 0 then break end
        local prefab = prefabs[math.random(1,#prefabs)]
        local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
        local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
        for j=1,10 do
            local ground = grounds[math.random(1,#grounds)]
            local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
            if not grid1Vo then
                warn("找不到地块坐标值",ground.Name)
            end
            local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
            local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
            if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Marsh) then continue end
            local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,gridType,prefab)
            -- building.Name = "沼泽区域宝箱点"
            MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
            building.Parent = parent
            break
        end
    end
end

-- 野猪王巢穴
function initBossEntrance()
    local prefab = _specialHouse:FindFirstChild("2x1,野猪王入口")
    local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
    local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
    local grounds:{Part} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround)
    local bossHousePos:Vector3
    for i=1,#grounds do
        local ground = table.remove(grounds,math.random(1,#grounds))
        local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
        local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
        local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
        local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
        if zoneLevel ~= 3 then continue end
        if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Marsh) then continue end
        local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,GridType.building,prefab,"空地块")
        MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
        building.Parent = _parent
        building:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MadPigCave)
        bossHousePos = building:GetPivot().Position
        print("生成野猪王入口",grid1X,grid1Z)
        break
    end
    prefab:Destroy()

    -- 野猪王Boss场地
    if bossHousePos then
        local bossHouse:Model = _parent:FindFirstChild("野猪王战场")
        if bossHouse then
            bossHouse:PivotTo(CFrame.new(bossHousePos.X,MapHelper.CaveY.WildBoarCave,bossHousePos.Z))
        end
    end
end

-- 野人之家
function initWildManHome()
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("沼泽Map"):FindFirstChild("土著村落")
    local prefabs = folder:GetChildren()
    local grounds:{Part} = CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.MarshGround)
    for i=1,5 do
        if #prefabs == 0 then break end
        if #grounds == 0 then break end

        local prefab = table.remove(prefabs,math.random(1,#prefabs))
        for j=1,100 do
            local ground = table.remove(grounds,math.random(1,#grounds))

            local grid1Vo = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
            local grid1X = grid1Vo.X
            local grid1Z = grid1Vo.Z
            local zoneLevel = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if zoneLevel < 4 or zoneLevel > 5 then
                print("生成土著村落 zoneLevel 不够",zoneLevel,grid1X,grid1Z)
                continue
            end
            local size = MapHelper:GetResPointSize(prefab)
            local sizeX,sizeZ = MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(size.X,size.Y)
            if not MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,MapHelper.GridType.Marsh) then continue end
            local building = MapHelper:CreateBuilding(grid1X,grid1Z,sizeX,sizeZ,GridType.building,prefab)
            MapHelper:initBuilding(building,MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z))
            building.Parent = _parent
            building:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.WildManHome)
            print("生成土著村落",grid1X,grid1Z)
            break
        end
    end
    folder:Destroy()
end

function spawnTreasureAndResItem(building:Model)
    local level = ValueHelper:WaitValueValue(building, BuildingValue.level)
    if not building.PrimaryPart then
        warn("Building does not have a PrimaryPart set:", building.Name)
        return
    end

    local resItemAtt:{Attachment} = {}
    for _,Attachment:Attachment in ipairs(building.PrimaryPart:GetChildren()) do
        if not Attachment:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
        if Attachment:HasTag("TreasurePoint") then
            if not GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName(Attachment.Name,Attachment.WorldCFrame) then
                local random = math.random(1,100)
                if random == 1 then -- 有%1几率创建神奇宝箱
                    GameHelper:CreateTreasureByName("神器宝箱",Attachment.WorldCFrame)
                else
                    GameHelper:CreateTreasure(level,Attachment.WorldCFrame)
                end
            end
        else
            table.insert(resItemAtt,Attachment)
        end
    end

    local count = #resItemAtt
    if count > 1 then
        count = math.random(1,count)
    end

    for i=1,count do
        local Attachment:Attachment = table.remove(resItemAtt,math.random(1,#resItemAtt))
        local item:Model = ResourcesItemHelper:CreateItemByRandomId(ResourcesItemHelper.ZoneRandomIds[level],Attachment.WorldCFrame.Position)
        if item.PrimaryPart then
            item.PrimaryPart.Anchored = false
            -- item.PrimaryPart:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
        end
        GameHelper.onSpawnResItem:Fire(Attachment)
        if item:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Gun) then
            GameHelper:CreateBulletFromGun(item)
        end
    end

    -- if #resItemAtt <= 2 then

function spawnEnemy(building:Model)
    local enemyPoints = building:FindFirstChild("敌人生成点")
    if enemyPoints then
        for _,pointAtt:Attachment in ipairs(enemyPoints:GetChildren()) do
            if not pointAtt:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
            local enemyId = tonumber(pointAtt.Name)
            if not enemyId then continue end

            local enemyLo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(enemyId)
            if not enemyLo then continue end

            local enemy:Model
            enemy = EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId,workspace)
            enemy:PivotTo(pointAtt.WorldCFrame)
            GameHelper.onBuildingSpawnEnemy:Fire(building,enemy)
        end
    end
end

GameHelper.BuildingEnterC2S.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player,building:Model)
    local enterKey = MapHelper:GetBuildingEnterPlayerKey(player)
    building:AddTag(enterKey)

    GameHelper.onBuildingEnter:Fire(player,building)

    if table.find(_buildingMarks,building) then return end
    table.insert(_buildingMarks,building)

    spawnTreasureAndResItem(building)
    spawnEnemy(building)
end)

        while character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.OnWater) do
